reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis invokes specific phases (δ-lamella, γ″) that are not established in W-based refractory HEAs and lacks a clear thermodynamic or kinetic justification for their sequential coherent precipitation in this system.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a decisive falsification criterion based on mechanical properties and TEM verification, though the baseline strength (600 MPa) seems unrealistically low for a W-based HEA.
reasons.usefulness: The idea of hierarchical coherent precipitates is interesting, but the choice of phases and alloy system appears speculative and not well-grounded in prior work, limiting its immediate value to researchers in the field.
